visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and a silver streak, wearing white-rimmed glasses and a grey polo shirt, sits at a light-colored wooden table in a restaurant. He holds a black ceramic cup with white Japanese calligraphy. The background is a minimalist grey wall with soft ambient lighting. (2) He uses wooden chopsticks to pick up a thick sushi roll with white fish and green herbs, bringing it to his mouth and eating it with an exaggerated expression of enjoyment. (3) He dips a piece of salmon nigiri into a small bowl of dark soy sauce and consumes it. Behind him, other patrons are blurred in the distance. (4) A large rectangular piece of yellow tamago (omelet) with a small ball of rice and seaweed on top sits on a wooden board. He eats it in one large bite, looking surprised. (5) A close-up shows two pieces of ikura (salmon roe) gunkan maki. He picks one up and eats it. (6) A large blue bowl filled with crushed ice holds several pieces of sashimi (tuna, salmon) and a lemon slice. He picks up a deep red piece of tuna sashimi and eats it. (7) A black and gold lacquered bento box filled with chirashi (scattered fish over rice) is presented. He eats from it, then notices some fish roe stuck to the inside of the red lid. (8) He points his chopsticks toward a small menu stand with a QR code on the table, then eats more white fish sushi. (9) He opens the lid of a dark blue bowl to reveal steaming miso fish soup, stirs it with a black spoon, and drinks it. (10) He holds the black cup again, looking directly at the camera while speaking, leaning slightly forward on the wooden table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male Mandarin speech opens the track with a bright, friendly tone. An upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 124 BPM beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX punctuates the cut to eating sounds. The speaker makes satisfied 'mmm' vocalizations. (3) The BGM continues with a driving bass line as the speaker describes the food's taste with high pitch variability. (4) Another 'pop' sound effect occurs during a scene transition. The speaker's arousal increases as he encounters a large piece of tamago. (5) Background restaurant murmurs are faintly audible but well below the speech level. (6) The speaker's voice lowers slightly in pitch as he explains the 'correct' way to eat sashimi, maintaining a professional but excited narrative tone. (7) Short melodic synth stabs in the BGM sync with visual cuts. (8) The audio finishes with a friendly concluding phrase and the speaker's tone remains positive and high-valence until the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of tasting events -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an engaging and high-energy food review of Midori Sushi. By combining rapid visual cuts of various appetizing Japanese dishes with the creator's expressive and positive reactions, it aims to showcase the quality and variety of the restaurant's offerings to a social media audience.
